title: Text-size gate assumed one em ratio; 25 px JetBrains Mono passed the 28 px floor
body:
## Summary
MEASURE_TEXT in check-design.mjs divided every text box by 1.21 em, but JetBrains Mono's box is 1.32 em, so 25-27 px mono text passed the owner's 28 px floor.

## Description
`.claude/skills/board/scripts/check-design.mjs:12` (HEAD) `LINE_TO_EM = 1.21` with its own comment saying JetBrains is 1.32; `:60` px = rect height / 1.21; `:183` allowance `MIN_TEXT_PX - 1`. Owner rule (memory, DESIGN repo law): every readable text >= 28 px is a harness rule. Fixed: each computed face measured once at 100 px (cached), allowance 0.5 px since measured heights are exact integers.

## Flow
- seat writes a 25 px JetBrains Mono label
- inspect measures 34 px box / 1.21 = 28.1 -> passes
- fix: 34 / 1.32 = 25.8 -> fails

## Expected impact
Seats can no longer ship sub-floor mono text (81 of 138 historical designs load JetBrains Mono). Could break: a design at exactly 27.x px now fails, which is the rule.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the 28 px floor binds for every staged face
Before: fixtures mono25 PASS, mono27 PASS, inter26 FAIL, base PASS
After: mono25 FAIL, mono27 FAIL, inter26 FAIL, base PASS (re-measured on the commit)
Method: probe - inspect() on OS-temp fixtures in Chrome; an in-repo browser fixture suite was deferred by the owner (vault rounds 5-6), so no gate
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
check-design.mjs:12 (HEAD) const LINE_TO_EM = 1.21; // ... JetBrains 1.32
heights (Chrome, 'Wins 12'): JetBrains 25:34 26:35 27:36 28:37; Inter 27:33 28:34; Barlow 27:32 28:34
81/138 arena designs reference JetBrains

title: Ledger skipped re-decided Board items; brief kept quoting withdrawn verdicts
body:
## Summary
applyFeedback was idempotent by item id only, so an undone-then-re-decided Board item was never re-folded and the brief kept its old verdict.

## Description
`.claude/skills/board/scripts/lib.mjs:18` (HEAD) `if (!it.decision || seen.has(it.id)) continue;`. The server's undo resets decided_at and the new decision sets it after the cursor (`apps/server/src/board.ts:150,135,186`), so /api/board/feedback returns the item again and it was skipped. Fixed: ledger.decisions records each folded decision; a changed one is taken back first; same decision stays a no-op; legacy items keep the skip.

## Flow
- owner rejects style neon, sync folds it
- owner undoes and accepts
- sync: id in seen -> skipped; brief still lists neon under rejected
- fix: old tally reversed, accept folded

## Expected impact
The brief seats read matches the owner's current verdicts. Could break: nothing; the ledger field is additive.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - ledger equals the Board after a re-decision
Before: new test red (neon style_rejects stays 1)
After: 36/36 then 41/41 green; accept after reject gives accepts 1, rejects 0, neon leaves {{styles_rejected}}
Method: gate - red-then-green unit test
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
lib.mjs:18 (HEAD) seen.has(it.id) continue
board.ts:150 undo sets decided_at null; :135 decide sets now(); :186 feedback filters decided_at > since
live DB copy vs vault ledger: 40 seen, 0 re-decided (latent)

## Flow

- none of t=4,12,20,28,36 sees it -> PASS
- fix: longevity sample t=7.27 sees it -> FAIL

## Expected impact

## Evaluation

Before: flash fixture PASS
After: flash FAIL 'Record falls' 20px; base PASS
Method: probe - inspect() on OS-temp fixtures (browser suite deferred)
Result: better

title: frameFacts pinned period.season to a race or career-start clock
body:
## Summary
assessFrameFacts compared period.season with floor(dataClock) for every unit, so any non-season design declaring frameFacts failed every frame.

## Description
`lib.mjs:301` (HEAD) pin without a unit guard while the sibling `assessClockLabels` (`lib.mjs:256`) skips non-season units. 37 of 138 historical designs use race or career-start clocks. Fixed: pin only when ctx.unit is season (default); check-design passes timeline.unit.

## Flow
- race-unit design (clock = round 2) declares {season 1990, round 2}
- check: 'period season 1990 but dataClock=2.00'
- fix: not compared for race units

## Expected impact
Race-by-race designs can use the frameFacts truth probe. Could break: nothing for season clocks.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - truth probe agrees with its sibling on units
Before: new test red
After: green; season clock still caught (1991.20 vs 1990)
Method: gate - red-then-green unit test
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Longevity coverage was the clock's own span, not its overlap with the timeline
body:
## Summary
assessLongevity divided max-min of the clock by the timeline span, so a clock in the wrong unit or outside the declared range passed the 85% coverage rule; Infinity passed too.

## Description
`lib.mjs:209` (HEAD) covered = (max - min) / span; `:205` NaN-only check. Fixed: overlap of [min,max] with [from,to]; non-finite clocks count as missing.

## Flow
- clock returns race index 0..1100 on a 1950-2026 season timeline
- coverage 1447% -> passes
- fix: 0%

## Expected impact
Coverage means what the docstring says. Could break: none of 114 harvested designs changed verdict.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - coverage rule as documented
Before: new test red (both wrong clocks pass)
After: coverage 0% and 39%, Infinity flagged; replay of 114 real harvested items: 0 changed
Method: gate - red-then-green unit test plus a replay over recorded samples (DB copy in temp)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
lib.mjs:209 (HEAD) const covered = (Math.max(...clocks) - Math.min(...clocks)) / span;
replay: { designsWithSamples: 114, oldFailing: 0, newFailing: 0, changed: 0 }

title: Seat pages' network requests were recorded (check) or ignored (harvest), never blocked
body:
## Summary
inspect only logged http(s) requests and harvest had no listener, so remote fonts, scripts or data loaded into checks and rendered cut-outs.

## Description
`check-design.mjs:133` (HEAD) page.on('request') push only; `board.mjs:253` (HEAD) nothing. SKILL.md 'No network at render time'; CLAUDE.md: data HTTP goes through the ingest clients. Fixed: exported blockNetwork() aborts http(s) in both; pinned by tests/test_check_design.mjs (stub page).

## Flow
- seat page loads https://cdn/... in a non-strict harvest
- request goes out, cut-out posted
- fix: aborted, logged

## Expected impact
No seat page can reach the network during checks or renders. Could break: designs relying on remote assets render without them (they already broke the rule).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - network requests reaching the stack
Before: 1 of 1 reached (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED)
After: 0 of 1 (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT); unit test seeded red by narrowing the pattern
Method: gate - stub-page unit test plus a fixture probe
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
check-design.mjs:133 (HEAD) page.on("request", (r) => /^https?:/.test(r.url()) && pageErrors.push(...))
board.mjs harvest: no request handling

title: Default harvest posts designs that never ran the text, safe-box, fact and truth gates
body:
## Summary
Without --strict, harvest runs only validateDesign, so designs that fail check.mjs (text < 28 px, attribution, facts, clock labels) still reach the Board, while seat-addendum says such a variant is 'discarded unseen'.

## Description
`board.mjs` harvest: `if (!errors.length && strict) inspect(...)`; SKILL.md step 3 documents `harvest --id <id>` without --strict; `references/seat-addendum.md:17-19` promises discard. The owner's 28 px rule is a harness rule. Fix: make the inspect gate the default (with an explicit opt-out), or post failing designs with the check errors as badges. Which one is a call on the owner's review flow, so measure first.

## Flow
- loop run, seat skips check.mjs
- harvest (default) posts a 20 px design
- owner reviews a design the rule forbids

## Expected impact
Owner sees only designs that obey the rules (or sees the failures labelled). Could break: fewer designs per loop.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - designs on the Board that failed check.mjs
Before: not measured: needs the arena's variants re-inspected
After: predicted 0 unlabelled failures
Method: simulation - simulation; the instrument is inspect() over every gk/loop arena variant (browser, minutes) plus a harvest mode switch in lib with a test
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
board.mjs: if (!errors.length && strict) { const r = await inspect(...) }
seat-addendum.md:19 'A variant that does not pass is discarded unseen.'
instrument: run inspect() over all 138 arena variants and count harvest-posted ones that fail; then extract harvest gating into lib.harvestGate(argv) with a test

title: One failing variant aborts the whole harvest and loses harvest.json
body:
## Summary
harvest has no per-variant try/catch around render and post; a throwing seek, ffmpeg or a 4xx aborts the run before harvest.json is written, and mass then logs 0 posted.

## Description
`board.mjs` harvest loop: renderCutout / measureLongevity / api('/api/board') unguarded; harvest.json written after the loop; mass reads it or `{posted: 0}` and counts a dry round (3 dry rounds stop the run).

## Flow
- variant 2 of 9 throws in seek
- harvest exits, browser not closed, no harvest.json
- mass logs 0 posted though variant 1 posted

## Expected impact
A bad variant costs itself, not the round. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - variants harvested after a failure
Before: predicted 0 after the first throw
After: predicted all remaining
Method: simulation - simulation; needs a harvest dry-run harness (no server, no MP4) to measure
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
board.mjs harvest: const cut = await renderCutout(...); ... await api("/api/board", ...) // no try
mass: h = existsSync(harvest.json) ? ... : { posted: 0, report: [] }
instrument: harvest with a stub api() and a fixture arena where one variant throws in seek(); count posted and check harvest.json exists

## Flow
- owner adds topic 'sailing'
- seat proposes topic sailing
- check-cases FAIL 'topic must be one of'

## Expected impact
Seats use the owner's current topic list. Could break: brief rendering if /api/topics is down (fallback to seed).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - topic list parity
Before: skill list = seed, server list = DB
After: predicted equal
Method: simulation - simulation; out-of-scope seam (server topics) and needs the server to measure
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
topics.ts:80 if (!t || !t.active) throw ...
lib.mjs:422 if (!CASE_TOPICS.includes(c.topic))

title: An undone Board decision is never removed from the ledger
body:
## Summary
After 7ba3640 a re-decision re-folds, but an undo without a new decision never comes back through /api/board/feedback (decided_at null), so its tally stays in the ledger and the brief.

## Description
`apps/server/src/board.ts:186-189` feedback filters decided items; `lib.mjs` applyFeedback has nothing to remove. Fix: sync also fetches the full decided set (no since) and takes back recorded decisions whose item is no longer decided; archived items need an owner call (keep or drop).

## Flow
- owner rejects, sync folds
- owner undoes and leaves it pending
- brief still quotes the reject

## Expected impact
Ledger equals the Board. Could break: archived decisions dropping out of tallies if handled naively.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - stale tallies
Before: 0 today (live ledger 40 = DB 40)
After: predicted 0 under undo
Method: simulation - simulation; needs a reconcile pass in sync (board.mjs) and a design call on archived items
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: board.ts:189 .filter((i) => i.status !== "archived" && i.decided_at && ...)

title: ffmpeg spawn failure is an unhandled error event in renderClip

Clear failure before seats' work is wasted. Could break: nothing.

Before: predicted unhandled ENOENT
After: predicted one-line refusal
Method: simulation - simulation; renderClip is not importable (board.mjs is a CLI) - needs a PATH-stripped harvest dry run
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: board.mjs renderClip: const ff = spawn("ffmpeg", [...]); ff.on("close", ...) // no "error"
